purpose: Repair the measured maintenance-triggered filtered slowdown without unconditionally disabling useful low-dimensional pruning. This is engineering using bounded algorithm portfolios, not an invention claim.
scope: Filtered pure-semantic document queries with no lexical query terms and a trained matching-dimension dense index. Existing unfiltered/hybrid/lexical routes stay outside this experiment.
candidate: Retain the already selected current document owners in the captured query. Allow the tree a fixed work budget floor(eligible_chunks * (dimensions + 1) / 16), charging dimensions before a bound or vector dot and one before a metadata predicate. On exhaustion discard the partial heap and exact-score the retained current snapshot. No store lock is reacquired and no source state is reconstructed from stale tree rows.
guaranteeScope: The budget bounds these counted operations, not wall time, allocations, heap comparisons or the capture phase. Returned results remain exact; a limited search never returns a partial result as complete.
correctness: Budget boundaries at required_work-1/required_work/required_work+1; exact ties and minima; captured snapshots across replacement/deletion/slot reuse; bounded deltas; query/result equality against independent scan. Run existing document/dense tests without weakening checks.
exposedCohort: Same 100K COCO/DEEP training vectors and first 32 calibration queries, baseline and 100 replacements plus 100 deletions/retrain, four original filters, three rotating repetitions. No test.f32 or held-out data.
additionalRegime: Four fixed cases: 8192 and 32768 documents, dimensions 2 and 4. First 256 vectors are [1,0,...], remaining vectors [-1,(id%5)/100,0,...], normalized by production preparation. Even IDs satisfy the filter. Each document has the same 1024-byte payload. Thirty-two queries [1,(ordinal-16)/1000,0,...], k=10, candidateLimit=100, minimum=-1, three rotating repetitions. Compare full original capture, bounded capture and exact scan; the original capture function is extracted verbatim except for initializing the new inactive scan field.
developmentGate: Every complete result field identical. On each nonempty filtered COCO/DEEP cell, bounded/scan median <=1.15 and 1%-filtered bounded/old-tree median <=0.125. On the declared low-dimensional favorable cases, bounded/old-tree median <=1.15 and tree completion must retain fewer exact dot evaluations than exhaustive scan. Failure prevents promoting this policy unchanged.
frozenArtifacts: Keep all previous calibration, package and Intel soak sources unchanged. Prototype in a separate copied source tree and retain patch/tests/raw timings. A successful prototype still requires a reviewed product patch, relevant tests, new builds and recalibration before qualification.
